content: The California State Athletic Commission sent a cease-and-desist letter to a startup that hosted a match between a human and a robot last month, as reported by The New York Times. The fight, which took place on September 18th, pitted a human, Frankie LaPenna, against a humanoid robot owned by a tech startup, Rek, that was being piloted by a human using what the NYT described as a “remote virtual-reality system.” Rek says it is the “the humanoid robot fighting league” on its website, and the robot appears to be one from EngineAI but with a Terminator-like head swapped on top. You can watch a replay of the fight on YouTube: [Media: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4rg2sB6ELtk] The CEO of Rek, Cix Liv, posted the letter to X on September 30th, which called the fight “unsanctioned” and demanded that Liv and REK stop “holding, promoting or advertising any boxing or mixed martial arts contest match, or exhibition, involving any human” in California without the approval of the California State Athletic Commission. “We made it boys,” Liv said. [Media: https://twitter.com/cixliv/status/2105443453807280336] Rek’s next planned match, which takes place on Friday, will feature two robots with weapons fighting each other. [Media: https://twitter.com/REK/status/2107916586527117467]

chineseContent: 据《纽约时报》报道，加州体育委员会向一家上个月举办人类与机器人比赛的初创公司发出了一封停止函。这场战斗发生在 9 月 18 日，人类弗兰基·拉彭纳 (Frankie LaPenna) 与科技初创公司 Rek 拥有的人形机器人展开对决，该机器人由人类使用《纽约时报》所描述的“远程虚拟现实系统”进行驾驶。 Rek 在其网站上表示，这是“人形机器人格斗联盟”，该机器人似乎来自 EngineAI，但顶部换了一个类似终结者的头部。您可以在 YouTube 上观看这场比赛的重播：[媒体：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4rg2sB6ELtk] Rek 首席执行官 Cix Liv 在 9 月 30 日向 X 发布了这封信，称这场比赛“未经批准”，并要求 Liv 和 REK 停止在未经加利福尼亚州批准的情况下在加利福尼亚州“举办、宣传或广告任何涉及任何人的拳击或综合格斗比赛或展览”体育委员会。 “我们成功了，男孩们，”丽芙说。 [媒体：https://twitter.com/cixliv/status/2105443453807280336]雷克计划的下一场比赛将于周五举行，届时将有两个携带武器的机器人互相战斗。 [媒体：https://twitter.com/REK/status/2107916586527117467]
